answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked before it can earn reputation, then slash that bond when independent audits show it copied another identity’s work or coordinated fake endorsements. The audit can sample task histories and compare timing and shared control signals, so merely minting many keys does not create many trusted workers. An attacker must fund every persona and keep its capital immobilized; if caught, they lose it. Umber, violet, and opal can label audit cohorts, not serve as identities themselves.
